source_row.stem: A nurse counsels a pregnant client taking carbamazepine for seizure control. The nurse should mention this medication carries risk of:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Improved fetal neurodevelopment, rather than the developmental risks this medication is actually associated with","B":"Only maternal risks, with no implications at all for the developing fetus during pregnancy","C":"Neural tube defects and other congenital malformations, requiring careful risk-benefit discussion and folic acid supplementation","D":"No fetal risk whatsoever, despite this medication's well-documented association with certain birth defects"}}
source_row.rationale: Carbamazepine carries a risk of neural tube defects and other congenital malformations when used during pregnancy, warranting careful risk-benefit discussion with the provider and folic acid supplementation.
